def get_grid(text,label):
    m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',text)
    if not m: return None
    h,w=map(int,m.groups()); lines=text[m.end():].splitlines()[:h]
    grid=[[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in lines]
    assert len(grid)==h and all(len(row)==w for row in grid),(label,h,w,[len(r) for r in grid])
    return grid
pairs=[]
for i in range(1,6):
    t=texts[i]
    inp=get_grid(t,f'Demo pair {i} input')
    out=get_grid(t,f'Demo pair {i} output')
    pairs.append((inp,out))
    diffs=[(r,c,inp[r][c],out[r][c]) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c]!=out[r][c]]
    print(i, len(inp),len(inp[0]),len(diffs),diffs[:20])
